title: Take Leave
label: ch:ur-take-leave
canDo: I can open a short Urdu conversation, ask how the other person is, and close it with khudā hāfiz. I can write choṭī ye and gol he, and name the face gol he wears in each position of a word.

payoff.summary: A four-line interaction with a beginning and an end: salām, the wellbeing check, then khudā hāfiz from both voices; then the farewell taken apart into khudā and hāfiz, read with its Urdu space, and choṭī ye and gol he written by hand.
payoff.note: UR-C05-practice is the chapter's last lesson (sequence 200, after UR-W05-he, now a prerequisite) and assesses all fourteen atoms the chapter introduces: the complete interaction, a spoken recall of khudā and hāfiz with their Persian and Arabic origins and the verbless 'God [be] guardian' formula, and a script section reading خدا, حافظ and spaced خدا حافظ against Persian's joined spelling, then writing ی and ہ.
